Soojin — quick draft framework below that should be legal-light and ops-friendly:

Proposal (high level):
- Cohort onboarding credit: 1,000,000 tokens total (pool shared across 5 teams) valid for 45 days.
- Billing: single invoice to Cobalt Labs for $X covering the credit pool; usage beyond pool billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
- Staggered conversion incentive: if 1 team converts to Dedicated within 60 days -> 15% off first 3 months of Dedicated; if 2+ teams convert -> 25% off first 3 months. Discounts only apply to the Dedicated base monthly commit (not seat add-ons).
- Revenue protection: require a 30% non-refundable deposit on the cohort invoice to protect revenue vs. heavy overages before conversion. Deposit is applied to first month of Dedicated if conversion happens.

Operational notes:
- Lauren can handle prorated drawdown accounting if we issue a single invoice and track usage by sub-account tag.
- Irene: confirm that deposit + conditional discount language is standard and won't trigger procurement pushback. If legal wants, we can replace percent-off language with a fixed $ credit.

I think this balances buyer flexibility with simple ops and a clear conversion incentive. I can convert this into an external-facing offer doc and a short Excel price matrix.

—Ben

Hi Maya / Adrian — thanks for the quick briefing and for the patience while we pulled this together. Below is the proposal we can execute immediately; I attached a short PDF you can share with the sponsor committee and an editable pricing matrix if you want to tweak numbers.

Executive summary:
- Cohort onboarding pool: 1,000,000 tokens shared across 5 teams (valid 45 days)
- Cohort invoice: single invoice to Cobalt Labs for $3,000 (covers the onboarding pool); 30% deposit due at signing ($900)
- Conversion incentives: 15% off first 3 months of Dedicated for 1 converting team; 25% off first 3 months for 2+ teams converting within 60 days. Deposit applies to first Dedicated invoice if conversion occurs.

Why this is safe:
- The pool size and short validity window limit exposure.
- Deposit protects against heavy pre-conversion consumption.
- Discount scoped to base commit (not addons) keeps margin predictable.

Next steps:
1) If you approve, sign the attached one-page MOU and return with deposit instructions.
2) We'll provision a single cohort billing account and provide API keys + onboarding notes for each team.
3) If conversion happens, we'll coordinate a simple Dedicated addendum (no complex legal review expected).

Attachments: Founders_Onramp_Offer_v1.pdf (summary + T&Cs), onramp-pricing-matrix.xlsx (breakdown)
